mapper.select: select t.image as cover, t.description as description, (select count(1) from share s where s.topic_id = t.id and s.status = 2) as participate_count from topic t where id = #{topicId}
select user_name, image from user_info where user_id = #{authorId}
mapper.insert: insert into browse (user_id, post_id, type, create_time) values (#{userId}, #{postId}, 1, now())
